help.blurb: Relative level of IR 1 in the blend. With a single IR loaded it has no effect.
help.tip: Cab levels balance the mix; use the Mix-page Level for overall volume.

help.blurb: Stereo position of IR 1 in the cab mix.
Mic distance for IR 1 (mm); the sub-ms delay creates inter-mic phase effects.
Proximity effect for IR 1 — adds low end as the virtual mic moves closer.
Master output level of the whole Cab block (on the Mix page).
Places the block output in the stereo field.
Virtual mic-preamp gain. Push it for warm to nasty preamp distortion.
Preamp saturation — the even/odd harmonic balance of the mic-preamp distortion.
Smooths out the peaks and notches of a mic’d IR for a more "in the room" feel.
Mutes IR 1. A muted IR uses no CPU — handy to save processing.
How the signal is routed when bypassed (e.g. muted, thru, or kept wet for trails).
Switches between Legacy IR-bank mode and the visual DynaCab cab/mic system.
When on, this block ignores scene changes.
